name: dj-claude-account-switcher
description: Switch the Claude Code account per VS Code window and see the active account and usage limits in the status bar.

claudeAccount.profiles.markdownDescription: Your Claude Code accounts, one profile each. Filled in by the **Set Up Accounts** command, which detects the accounts already signed in on this computer. An empty `configDir` uses the default Claude Code directory (`~/.claude`). A profile with its own `configDir` keeps its own sign-in and shares skills, agents, plugins, memory and history with the default directory through junctions (symbolic links outside Windows).

name.description: Name shown in the status bar.

email.description: Expected account email. Used to warn when the directory is signed in with a different account.

configDir.description: Claude Code configuration directory for this profile (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Accepts ~ for the home folder. Empty uses ~/.claude.

claudeAccount.defaultProfile.description: Profile used by a window that has not picked one yet. Empty uses the first profile.

claudeAccount.usage.liveQueries.markdownDescription: Fetch live usage from `api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage` with the profile token when the Claude Code cache is stale. When off, the status bar shows only what Claude Code stored in `.claude.json`.

claudeAccount.usage.liveMinIntervalMinut.description: Minimum interval, in minutes, between live usage requests for the same profile (shared across all windows).

claudeAccount.usage.refreshIntervalSecon.description: Interval, in seconds, between local reads of the usage cache and the profile credentials.

claudeAccount.usage.warnAtPercent.description: The status bar turns yellow at this percentage and red at 100%.

claudeAccount.applyToTerminals.description: Apply the window profile to integrated terminals created after the selection, so the claude command in the terminal uses the same account. Terminals that are already open must be restarted.

claudeAccount.profileDir.syncFiles.description: Files from ~/.claude kept identical in every profile (the newest copy wins and the replaced one is saved as .bak). Credentials and .claude.json are never synced.
